title: Barite (BaSO$_{4}$, $H0_{2}$) Structure
comments:
At high temperatures BaSO$_{4}$ transforms into the cubic \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC4_cF24_216_a_b_e-001}{$H0_{2}$ structure}. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP24_62_c_2cd_c-001}{Barite ($H0_{2}$)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP24_62_c_2cd_c-002}{low-temperature LiBH$_{4}$} have the same AFLOW prototype label, AB4C\_oP24\_62\_c\_2cd\_c. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
